_comment: CLAY, STAGE ONE (#115). Grog IS crushed potsherds - the vanilla item and the real material are
the same noun, so the recipe needs no explaining.
The issue says Separator; it predates the machine split and #189's table lists 'pottery sherd to
grog' under the Pulverizer. Crushing changes only how fine the material is, which is the mill's
THE TAG, not twenty-three recipes. #minecraft:decorated_pot_sherds carries all of them, so a
sherd added by a future version or a pack is covered without a mod release - and every sherd
crushes the same, because the picture on it does not survive being ground.
